CustomField.description: Public HTTPS origin visitors actually reach the consumer site on (no trailing slash), e.g. https://app.skywave.flights when fronted by a custom domain. This is the value the join-QR must encode so phones land on the SAME origin the Heroku CORS gate (SKYWAVE_PUBLIC_ORIGIN) allows — otherwise POSTs (session/peek, session/init) are 403'd and the visitor is misclassified as new. Read via Skywave_HerokuConfig.publicSiteUrl(); falls back to Heroku_Origin_Url__c when blank (single-origin installs with no custom domain).
CustomField.label: Public Site URL
